channel.title: Asia News
channel.description: Read the latest stock market news and analysis on Asia Pacific in regions from Japan, China, Singapore, Australia, to New Zealand. Find business; finance; economy, stocks, and global economy news on CNBC's Asia Pacific page.

item.title: CNBC Daily Open: Tech falls to earth, Musk's fortunes diverge
item.description: Markets are digesting the tech rout on Wall Street with the Nasdaq Composite logging its worst day in three months on renewed doubts over AI spending.

item.title: Volvo Cars plunges 24% as CEO says China sales slump came 'faster than we thought'
item.description: The Swedish automaker cited a deteriorating environment led by "tougher" market conditions in China and the U.S., which "negatively affected free cash flow."

item.title: Wealthy Chinese move offshore money to U.S. banks as Beijing’s tax net widens
item.description: Bankers and lawyers say Chinese clients' demand for U.S. bank accounts has gathered pace as Beijing tightens the screws on Chinese offshore wealth.

item.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
item.description: Core inflation, which strips out prices of fresh food, was in line with the 2.1% forecast by economists polled by Reuters.

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says he sees no sign of a 2029 memory glut: 'You can always use more'
item.description: Nvidia's Jensen Huang told CNBC that a surplus of memory supply is unlikely by 2029, as memory stocks have taken a beating in the past week.

item.title: CNBC Daily Open: Ukraine's Starlink whodunit
item.description: Washington says it has no plans to renew strikes on Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, but escalation may not wait long after that.

item.title: China's stock market sinks into bear territory as CSI 300 extends 10-week rout
item.description: China's benchmark CSI 300 index has entered bear-market territory, falling 20% from its June peak, as a prolonged selloff in mainland equities deepens.

item.title: CNBC Daily Open: War worries meet AI anxiety
item.description: Washington says it has no plans to renew strikes on Iran before the Nov. 3 midterms, but escalation may not wait long after that.

item.title: Southeast Asia is hungry for AI — and the money isn't just in subscriptions
item.description: Southeast Asia's rapid AI adoption is creating business opportunities beyond paid consumer subscriptions, a partner at Bain & Company, told CNBC.

item.title: Bank of Korea holds rates after President Lee calls for boosting housing supply
item.description: Economists polled by Reuters had forecast the Bank of Korea to hold rates.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Asia’s hottest data center market aims to quell concerns over water and power use
item.description: India is grappling with growing public anger against data centers that pose a threat to its ambitions to host the whole world's data.

item.title: Australian data center operator NextDC's shares plunge 40% after it slashes earnings forecast
item.description: The company cited power supply delays at its Melbourne facility amid local community and stakeholder opposition for lowering earnings forecast.

item.title: Japan exports post huge miss in September as growth slows to 16.7%
item.description: Japan's imports grew 18.9%, also missing expectations of 19.6% from Reuters.

item.title: U.S. bans DeepSeek from government agency systems amid AI rift with China
item.description: U.S. Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek-related technology from federal civilian agency IT systems.

item.title: 'Cannot play hide and seek': Minister's warning over haze sends Singapore agricultural stocks lower
item.description: Singapore Senior Minister Shanmugam said the Singapore Exchange had questioned seven firms about their operations and possible links to the haze.

item.title: Bank Indonesia faces mounting pressure to hike after MSCI threat fuels market rout
item.description: Bank Indonesia faces growing pressure to raise rates after MSCI’s threat to cut its market to standalone status triggered a rout in stocks, weakened the rupiah.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Navigating a tech-heavy world
item.description: While economists and former central bankers discuss tech and monetary policy at the Bund Summit, companies are moving faster to capture new revenue.

item.title: China's third-quarter economic growth quickens to 4.5% as exports surge, beating estimates
item.description: China's economic growth accelerated in the third quarter, as foreign demand for the country's technological goods largely offset sluggish consumer demand.

item.title: China's CXMT shares fall nearly 8% as investors look past chipmaker's profit turnaround
item.description: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.

item.title: Semiconductor market to remain solid ‘at least through next year,’ South Korea finance minister says
item.description: South Korea's finance minister said semiconductor growth can last at least through 2027 as supply remains tight despite a global chip sell-off.

item.title: U.S. presses China on Mastercard, Citigroup market access in bilateral Bangkok talks, official says
item.description: The U.S. raised market access issues for Mastercard and Citigroup in China during bilateral meetings in Bangkok this week, a U.S. Treasury official says.

item.title: Marco Rubio to visit Indian billionaire Ambani's refinery in Gujarat as U.S. diesel prices surge
item.description: Not only is Ambani's Reliance investing in a U.S. refinery and buying Venezuelan oil, but its strong ability to supply diesel has put Jamnagar on the map during Rubio's visit.

item.title: Hybe shares jump 10% as K-pop sensation BTS' tour lifts earnings hopes
item.description: BTS' world tour and rising global demand for newer K-pop acts are fueling earnings expectations, sending Hybe shares soaring.

item.title: India's rupee forecast to weaken toward 100-per-dollar level even as RBI pushes back
item.description: The RBI's latest moves have helped the rupee recover from 96.79 rupees per dollar to the 95-level over recent days.

item.title: Gasping for clean air: Singapore battles relentless haze as Prime Minister Wong warns of action
item.description: Singapore continues to grapple with severe haze that is disrupting daily life and businesses, as authorities roll out protective measures — and issue warnings.

item.title: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
item.description: TSMC reported its third-quarter earnings on Thursday.

item.title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms to raise up to $3.2 billion in historic IPO in India
item.description: Jio's share sale will be India's largest ever in rupee terms, and second largest in dollar terms, trailing the Hyundai Motors IPO that raised $3.3 billion in 2024.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: Billionaire Ambani’s mega-IPO faces a valuation reality check amid Musk spat
item.description: Jio Platforms, the company at the center of Musk’s remarks, is launching an IPO later this month.

item.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
item.description: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

item.title: South Korean carmaker Hyundai plans 'strategic' investment of $15.5 billion in India by 2032
item.description: Korean car company Hyundai says India is a strategic core market
